tamedphantomsscream.cooldown: The phantom's scream will be ready in %s s.
advancements.tamedphantomsscream.sick_mo: Hear a released phantom cry under a full moon
tamedphantomsscream.guide.page.1: This addon is the scream. Without it, a tamed phantom never cries. While the owner is riding, a press of $(k:key.tamedphantoms.scream)$() that did not pull out of a loop and did not charge a barrel roll makes the phantom cry. The cry is deep and much louder. For one second the eyes burn red and the body glows. Mobs in range flee and go blind. Anyone on this phantom is spared. The first cry grants $(thing)Winged Beast$(). A press that adds barrel-roll speed keeps the key quiet for five seconds.
tamedphantomsscream.guide.page.2: The cry then needs about four seconds. A red line tells you how long is left. Radius and cooldown are this addon's server settings. A defending phantom cries the same way. A released phantom sometimes cries at a nearby mob for play, without blindness, and then stays quiet for a while. On a full moon a released phantom may cry with no fight: the eyes stay yellow, the glow still flashes, mobs flee, nobody is blinded, and the moon turns a sickly yellow for that second. Hearing it grants the secret advancement $(thing)Sick Moon$().
tamedphantomsscream.guide.page.3: One cry blinds for one second. Several cries at once last longer when stacked screams is on: two cries last two seconds, and nine or more last eight. From the third cry, players and mobs take a little magic damage that ignores armor, up to ten health at nine cries. Only wild phantoms are frightened. An owner riding any of their phantoms, and anyone riding with them, is spared from all of that owner's phantoms.
tamedphantomsscream.guide.page.4: When you cry from the saddle, every other tamed phantom of yours that can hear it answers at once, even if its own cry was not ready. A cry in self-defense, in play, or under a full moon does not call them.
